summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a 100x+ range, from sub-cent lightweight models to $15+ per million input tokens for frontier reasoning models, with vendors increasingly pricing by task tier rather than a single flagship rate. Prompt caching (typically 10x cheaper cached input) and batch processing (usually 50% off) have become standard cost levers, and most major providers now offer a free tier or trial credits. Note that the live research data primarily covers Google's rapidly shifting Gemini lineup; prices below reflect officially published rates and should be reconfirmed on each vendor's pricing page as changes are frequent.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Pricing may vary by snapshot; verify current rate on official pricing page.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost small model. Batch API 50% discount available.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads ~10x cheaper; cache writes cost more. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available via Google AI Studio. Batch requests cost half price. Verify current rate as Google updates its rate card frequently.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost model. Prompt caching and batch (50% off) supported.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: higher rates for prompts over 200K tokens. Free tier via Google AI Studio; batch at half price.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Frontier reasoning model; price reduced in 2025. Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch 50% off.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Highest-tier Anthropic model. Prompt caching ~10x cheaper reads; batch 50% off.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.notes: At 200K tokens or more the whole request bills at $4.00/$12.00 per million.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimentation tier via La Plateforme. Verify current rate on official pricing page.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model; free tier available via La Plateforme.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Together AI)
models.notes: Pricing varies by Llama variant and size (e.g. Llama 70B-class). Free trial credits available. See Together pricing page for exact per-model rates.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Groq)
models.notes: High-throughput LPU inference; rates vary by Llama model size. Free tier available. See Groq pricing for exact per-model rates.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Fireworks AI)
models.notes: Serverless per-token pricing varies by model parameter tier. Free trial credits. See Fireworks pricing for exact rates.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial API keys available (rate-limited). Strong at RAG and tool use.
